selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific model/type of the firearm matches the 'assault rifle' class label and identify any anomalous features.
To audit the anatomical correctness of the human holder, specifically hand placement on the weapon and arm structure.
To check for edge bleeding or fusion between the rifle (hard surface) and the human/clothing (soft surface), especially around the hands and stock.
To ensure the rifle sits correctly in 3D space relative to the holder and does not exhibit warping or impossible depth relationships.
To analyze the gibberish text in the corner and determine if it's a signature artifact or nonsensical AI text.

focus_areas: Hand-rifle interaction (grip and trigger finger anatomy)
Rifle stock connection to shoulder (boundary sharpness)
Magazine well and ejection port structural logic
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the hands holding the rifle. AI often struggles with fingers wrapping around cylindrical objects like pistol grips and handguards. Check if the fingers merge with the gun or have incorrect joint counts. Also, scrutinize the stock area where it meets the body; look for 'melting' of the gun into the clothes. Verify if the optic scope has a logical lens structure or if it's just a blob.
